item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to Guangdong today and tomorrow. A replenishment of the monsoon will reach southern China on Sunday. It will be windy and become cooler over the coastal areas early to midweek next week. The tropical cyclone over the seas east of Luzon will move across the vicinity of the Luzon Strait on Sunday. It will bring unsettled weather to the northeastern part of the South China Sea. However, there are still uncertainties in its subsequent development and movement. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Sonca will move across the inland areas of Vietnam and dissipate gradually today.
